articles.title: 4 FIRs over INDIA bloc march; takedown request for 500 pieces of content
articles.summary: Delhi Police have filed four FIRs regarding protests linked to the INDIA bloc and associated violations. These cases involve barricade violations and road defacement, according to police sources.

articles.title: CJP’s Das, Ranka sent to Tihar Jail for 5 days over Jantar Mantar trespass
articles.summary: Cockroach Janata Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were arrested for violating protest-related regulations. They allegedly breached barricades and entered a protest site designated for demonstrations.

articles.title: Bittu Tabahi ‘heartbroken’ after finding garbage in river he cleaned for 8 months
articles.summary: Bittu Tabahi's return to the Ajnar River after an eight-month cleanup revealed a heartbreaking reality; the river was heavily polluted again. In a poignant video, he shared his frustration and vowed to keep documenting the situation.

articles.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi drops two-word message ahead of India vs West Indies 4th T20I
articles.summary: India will look to seal the five-match T20I series when they face the West Indies in the fourth match at the Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium in Hyderabad on Wednesday. With India leading the series 2-1, the possibility of 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi getting a chance has once again become a major talking point..

articles.title: Billionaire wins appeal overturning A$23.4 million tax bill tied to Tasmania's Woolnorth dairy estate
articles.summary: A Full Court in Tasmania has overturned a significant tax assessment against companies related to Xianfeng Lu. The decision cancels a A$23.4 million stamp duty bill that included penalties and interest.

articles.title: Shreveport's former Libbey Glass plant faces demolition, with 95% of materials set for recycling
articles.summary: Full-scale demolition of the former Libbey Glass plant in Shreveport is now underway and progressing. Environmental contaminants have been cleared over the 54-acre site, allowing for redevelopment opportunities.

articles.title: Iowa farmer turns to solar leases paying $1,200 per acre as falling crop prices squeeze profits
articles.summary: Tom Green, an Iowa farmer, backs the Folsom Lake Solar Project after it secured the green light from the Mills County Zoning Board. This initiative is set to ensure reliable income through long-term land leases amid tough farming conditions.

articles.title: RHOP star Mia Thornton faces felony theft charge over alleged $11,000 Atlanta condo furniture removal
articles.summary: Former The Real Housewives of Potomac star Mia Thornton faces a felony theft-by-taking charge over allegations that she and Jared McGriff removed furniture and a television worth approximately $11,000 from a furnished Atlanta condo in October 2025. The case follows Thornton’s November airport arrest over an outstanding larceny warrant.

articles.title: Stock market today: BSE Sensex off to choppy start, Nifty50 slips below 22,700
articles.summary: Indian shares are set for a muted opening on Wednesday after rallying in the previous session, as rising oil prices and sustained foreign fund outflows weighed on investor sentiment amid the ongoing corporate earnings season. GIFT Nifty futures stood at 22,764 at 7:50 am IST, signalling a muted start for the Nifty 50, which closed at 22,721.95 on Tuesday.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: 'Jailer 2' first review: Rajinikanth starrer is a 'Silent Sambavam'
articles.summary: The buzz around Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' is palpable, with pre-bookings soaring beyond Rs 50 crore. Hit the cinemas on October 15 to witness the film’s highly anticipated moments, teased intriguingly by actor Bjorn.

articles.title: ‘Breaking Bad’ actor RJ Mitte's cause of death CONFIRMED
articles.summary: RJ Mitte, best known for his role as Walter White Jr. in 'Breaking Bad', has died at 34.

articles.title: Ben Affleck says Bruce Willis advised him not to work on ‘Shakespeare in Love'
articles.summary: During a podcast discussion, Ben Affleck opened up about early career guidance from Bruce Willis, who advised him against participating in 'Shakespeare in Love' because of his vocal pitch. Affleck appreciated Willis's concern, showcasing a mentor's protective intent.

articles.title: 'Jana Nayagan' revenue-sharing row resurfaces ahead of 'Jailer 2' release
articles.summary: Rajinikanth's highly anticipated film 'Jailer 2' is set to hit theaters on October 15, but complications have arisen over revenue-sharing arrangements. Distributors are insisting on a 75% share of the box-office earnings, whereas theatre owners can only grant 65%.
